name: wmkf_appreviewersuggestion-identity-coi
_comment: Additive proposal-specific COI currency for the reviewer holistic redesign. These columns are deliberately non-authoritative at schema delivery. Current save/send behavior remains unchanged until a later owner-approved dual-write/read cutover; null or a binding-version mismatch will then be treated as unknown/stale and fail closed for identity-dependent actions.

attributes.description: Server-owned proposal-specific institution COI result for the recorded binding generation: clear | conflict | unknown. Staleness is determined by comparing IdentityCoiBindingVersion with the person's current IdentityBindingVersion.
Person identity-binding generation used to compute this proposal-specific COI result. Null or mismatch means unknown/stale.

Lowercase SHA-256 hex of the canonical authoritative proposal-side COI inputs plus the COI rule version. A missing or mismatched hash means the recorded COI result is stale even when the person binding generation is unchanged.
Timestamp when the proposal-specific identity COI result was computed for IdentityCoiBindingVersion.
